Need short grace period. I’m extremely disappointed with Airbnb after a very frustrating experience.

I accidentally booked accommodation for the wrong month. I realized my mistake within seconds and cancelled the reservation almost immediately. The reservation existed for less than a minute, yet I am now potentially losing 500+ USD because the cancellation policy does not provide even a short grace period for obvious booking mistakes.

I understand that hosts need cancellation policies and protection. However, there should be at least a few minutes to correct an accidental booking before such a large amount becomes non-refundable. People make simple mistakes, especially when booking dates months in advance, and a platform as large as Airbnb should have a reasonable mechanism for handling them.

I immediately contacted the host, explained everything, and was willing to book the correct dates and even pay more if necessary. Unfortunately, the host refused to help, and Airbnb support has so far been unable to provide a meaningful solution.

This experience is especially disappointing because the amount involved is significant, and the reservation was cancelled almost immediately. I also had problems with Airbnb’s SMS verification system, and the support team repeatedly provided generic advice that did not actually solve the problem.

I genuinely hope Airbnb changes this policy in the future. A short grace period for accidental bookings would prevent situations like this and would make the platform feel much more reasonable and human.

After this experience, I will seriously reconsider using Airbnb again.

I had a very frustrating experience with this app.. I had a very frustrating experience with this app.

I made a booking which was later cancelled, yet I was still charged. Agoda claimed I was not charged, but my bank confirmed that the transaction was successfully completed.

What’s worse is that the system created a second booking without my clear intention, marked it as non-refundable, and then refused to process a refund. This is extremely misleading and unfair.

The cancellation policy was not clearly explained, especially the difference between “no-show” and “non-refundable,” which caused confusion.

Customer service only gave generic responses and kept shifting responsibility instead of resolving the issue properly.

I would not recommend using this app unless you are 100% sure about your booking. Otherwise, you may risk losing your money with no proper support. 

I will be reporting this issue and sharing my experience publicly if it is not resolved.
